basis: Root coordination message after independent endpoint QA596/596 and pair QA195/195; no new DFT submission.

R13_pair_review.scope: The two endpoints support similar rearranged structures; the missing parent site remains empty. Both pass the force/stress endpoint gates. This is not a global-minimum or complete numerical-transfer certification.
R13_pair_review.electronic_precision_note: Same physical functional, pseudopotential and grid; new 0V uses TN/econv1e-11 while original accepted 1V uses LBFGS/econv1e-9. Formation-energy electronic-precision sensitivity is not separately completed.

five_size_interpretation: Five numerical endpoint pairs are now available. R13 Ef is greater than R15 Ef, so the results are not strictly monotonic in size. R11 and R13 include significant rearrangement; structure matching and numerical sensitivity remain part of interpretation.
summary_ZH: 這次能量下降約0.951 eV，伴隨明顯的原子重排。R13完整柱與含空缺柱相對原始理想柱的位移都很大；但把兩個鬆弛終態逐原子對齊、扣掉晶胞形變後，RMS差只有0.02994 Å，最大差0.10532 Å。這支持它們具有相似的重排後結構，缺格仍留在原本的parent_site_id 33。
pair_scope_ZH: 五組數據可用來比較已達力／應力門檻的端點，但不能寫成單純的『半徑越大，形成能越高』：R13形成能高於R15。小柱的整體結構重排與空缺造成的額外反應需分開說明。結晶相分類、全域最低能與網格／真空／電子精度對形成能的敏感度，仍各有待驗證的範圍。
